TB Notes: Per-lot net premium normalization. Sign-aware: negative = net debit paid (e.g. long calendars/diagonals), positive = net credit received (e.g. short condors/strangles). Same trade structure may flip sign based on parameter choices.
OO Notes: OO labels as db (debit) / cr (credit). Sign captured in this CSV column: negative = db, positive = cr.
Implication: Net premium per lot at entry. Sign indicates trade type (debit vs credit). Magnitude correlates with VIX (higher vol -> richer premium) but measured per-trade.
Computation: premium / num_contracts
tool_tip_info: Net premium per 1-lot of the structure at entry, in price units (notional / 100). SIGN MATTERS: negative = debit paid (long volatility / spread cost), positive = credit received (short volatility / income strategy). Could be either depending on the structure. Same trade type can flip sign based on parameter choices (e.g. a calendar can be debit OR credit depending on strike width and DTE). Calc: sum(qty x signed_leg_price) / num_contracts from OO trade log. Anti-correlated r=-1.00 with margin_per_contract.

TB Notes: Per-contract margin normalization
Implication: Trade-specific. Driven by wing width and underlying price, not market regime.
Computation: margin_req / num_contracts
tool_tip_info: Margin required per 1-lot of the structure at entry, in dollars. Higher = wider spreads or more vol-sensitive structure. Calc: margin_req / num_contracts from OO trade log; anti-correlated r=-1.00 with premium_per_contract.
